toml:
# GNSS on a lunar transfer, with a weak-signal receiver that earns its sensitivity.
#
# A two-body outbound ellipse from a 185 km perigee to the Moon's distance. Beyond about 10 earth radii the signals are below
# 20 dB-Hz; whether a receiver can use them depends on its design, so the threshold here is not a number but a receiver: a
# 100 ms coherent integration on a pilot channel, 100 non-coherent sums, an Earth-orbit-aided Doppler search of +/-200 Hz over a
# 50-chip code window, and a carrier loop of 1 Hz once the dynamics are aided away. The model derives the C/N0 at which such
# a receiver acquires (detection 0.9 at a total false-alarm probability of 1e-3) and applies it as the availability threshold.
#
# A trajectory in the booklet's lunar case is a propagated one; this is a Keplerian stand-in with the same endpoints, so its
# availability is indicative. MODELLED throughout.

kind = "gnss-ssv"
name = "Lunar transfer, weak-signal receiver, parametric sidelobes"

[constellations]
include = ["gps", "galileo", "glonass", "bds"]
bands = ["l1", "l5"]

[transmit]
pattern = "parametric"

[receiver]
apply = "acquisition"

[receiver.weak_signal]
t_coh_s = 0.1
n_noncoherent = 100.0
pilot_or_data_wipe = true
pfa_total = 1.0e-3
pd = 0.9
doppler_uncertainty_hz = 200.0
code_window_chips = 50.0
pll_bn_hz = 1.0
pll_t_s = 0.02
doppler_rate_hz_per_s = 0.05

[trajectory]
preset = "lunar-transfer"
duration_min = 3600.0
step_min = 30.0
antennas = ["booklet-high-gain-nadir"]
series_every_min = 240.0
